idea-plugin.name: EU Health Claim Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Finds unauthorised nutrition and health claims in your product-page HTML and Markdown and names the article that bans each one. 19 rules; the demo page shipped with it returns 24 findings, 13 of them outright prohibitions, and the clean page returns 0.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → EU Health Claim Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 19 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/eu-health-claim-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/eu-health-claim-lint

action.text: EU Health Claim Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run EU Health Claim Lint on the file in the editor
